changes.text: equalise the heights of the dock row so Coming up and the Contents plate end together, and shrink the tube column on Settings, Status and Plans so the lists get more width
thin the chrome: fewer plates; while setup is unfinished, Finish setting up comes first on Home
give the Home question one size more weight so it wins when squinted
light the question mark to match MIND exactly
ledger rows with leaders, tabular facts, amber 'was due N days ago' stamps and a fine lit rail down To do, as in Docked Track
raise the 9px mono kickers and the tab labels to at least 12px, and take the Settings and To do titles down one step so they stop being walls
phone: the poster question takes about a third of the first screen so the starters show above the fold; shorten the dotted leader beside short chat lines
one quiet lit corner tick on the active or primary cell only, not on every cell
Add something to do is a visible key, the Filter select becomes pills, and the phone Send shows its word as well as the icon, with the taller composer of Docked Track
lift the dim ink-2 text one step and make the kind colours in the cell labels a touch stronger so the difference from the parent shows at half size
